plan.goal: Generate and triage one small de novo protein candidate with sequence, predicted structure, QC, and final ranking evidence.
assumptions: A single unconditional 60-residue backbone is an acceptable proxy for a compact soluble de novo design target.

Available solubility-relevant evidence is approximate and will be inferred from GRAVY, instability index, polybasic content, pI, and predicted structure confidence rather than an explicit solubility predictor.
Producing one backbone and one inverse-folded sequence satisfies the requirement to generate at most one candidate.
